title: About

sections_json.lede: NC Global Assets was founded by entrepreneurs who understood firsthand how hard it is to bring an international brand into a new market — especially one as dynamic and nuanced as Thailand.
sections_json.headline: Our Story
sections_json.body_para1: We saw brilliant brands fail not because their product was wrong, but because they tried to build everything from scratch, alone, without local knowledge or operational infrastructure. We decided to build that infrastructure ourselves.
sections_json.body_para2: Today, our Bangkok building — with its cloud kitchen, offices and showroom — is the operational base from which we help international brands test, launch and grow across Thailand and Southeast Asia. Not as consultants. As partners with skin in the game.

items.title: Real Skin in the Game
items.description: We're not advisors. We share the upside and downside of your launch. Your success is our success.

items.title: Local Expertise + Global Perspective
items.description: Deep Thailand knowledge combined with international brand experience. The best of both worlds.

items.title: Execution First
items.description: We move fast. Talk less, build more. Real revenue from day one, not roadmaps in 18 months.

items.title: Long-Term Partner
items.description: We invest in your growth across Thailand and Southeast Asia. Think in years, not campaigns.

sections_json.body: The NC Global Assets team brings 15+ years of combined experience in brand launches, F&B operations, and Southeast Asian market entry across tech, hospitality, and FMCG sectors.

members.bio: Digital marketing director with 6+ years of experience leading paid media, brand activation and go-to-market strategies for companies entering new markets. Deep understanding of the Thai consumer — connecting strategy, content and local execution.

members.bio: Entrepreneur and founder of Startups Factory — 15+ years in startups, open innovation, digital growth and international expansion. Worked with ICEX, Playtomic and other innovation-driven ventures.
